description: [Approved mode — write] This tool creates a record in Pushizo. It only creates a DRAFT and never sends or schedules a message; the API key needs the `mcp:write` scope. Get explicit approval from the user before calling it. Creates a page-content personalization experience as `draft`; does not publish it (plan feature `web_personalization`). Changes target page elements by CSS selector; only text, image, link, hide and show are allowed (no HTML). Example: changes [{"action":"text","selector":"#hero h1","text":{"en":"A deal for you"}}], conditions {"url_rules":[{"op":"starts_with","value":"/"}]}.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

changes.description: Element changes applied when there is no A/B test (get_web_personalization `changes` format).

variants.description: A/B variants (id, name, weight_percent, changes); a variant with no changes is the control group.

name: create_web_personalization_draft
title: Create web personalization draft
